claim: If the order is still being prepared 8 minutes after check-in, send a Pickup Delay report to Dispatch.
reason: Matches the v3 threshold and operator; it may go to trainer review but is not yet approved.

claim: إذا بقي الطلب قيد التجهيز بعد ٨ دقائق من تسجيل الوصول، أرسل بلاغ «تأخر الاستلام» إلى مسؤول التوزيع.
reason: Arabic-Indic ٨ equals the printed ASCII 8 in v3; a gate must compare values, not glyphs.

claim: Wait 15 minutes after check-in before reporting a pickup delay to Dispatch.
reason: Teaches the superseded 15-minute timer against a v3 citation that says 8.

claim: Report a pickup delay once more than 8 minutes have passed since check-in.
reason: The rule applies at 8 minutes (>=); 'more than 8' tells couriers to keep waiting at exactly 8.

claim: أرسل بلاغ «تأخر الاستلام» إذا مرّ أكثر من 8 دقائق على تسجيل الوصول.
reason: «أكثر من 8» excludes the 8-minute mark at which the v3 rule already applies.

claim: Report a pickup delay to Dispatch 15 minutes after check-in.
reason: Faithful to v1, but v1 is superseded by courier-pickup-wait-v3; new training must cite the current version.

claim: If the customer has not answered 5 minutes after you send the request, mark the item unavailable.
reason: PS-03 allows 7 minutes for the customer to answer.

claim: If the customer has not answered 7 minutes after you send the request, mark the item unavailable and notify Partner Support.
reason: Matches the PS-03 threshold, start event and action.
